title.en: Reading list: modern East Asian history

intro.en: A systematic reading list on Chinese and Japanese history from the seventeenth through the twentieth century: the late imperial Qing, Tokugawa Japan, the crises of nineteenth-century China, the Meiji Restoration, Japan’s economic transformation, the Chinese revolution and early Republic, Meiji and Taishō politics, China under the Guomindang, Japanese imperialism and war, China under and after Mao, postwar Japan, and women in modern Japan. The books are well regarded in English-language scholarship, and several have received the John K. Fairbank Prize.
intro.zh: 这份书单系统全面，主要涵盖 17 至 20 世纪的中国和日本历史：清代中国、德川日本、19 世纪中国的危机、明治维新、日本的经济转型、辛亥革命与民国初年、明治与大正时期的日本政治、国民党统治下的中国、日本的帝国扩张与战争、毛泽东时代及其后的中国、战后日本，以及近代日本女性的地位。这些书在海外学术界口碑良好，其中几本获得过费正清奖，被视为东亚近现代史研究的佳作。
